title: PaidProposal
description: A structured record of a proposal to enable a paid service. No paid call may be made unless a matching record here has status 'approved' (TECHNICAL-SPEC-EN.md section 5). The 25 USD emergency ceiling is a hard cap, not budget available to spend.

estimated_monthly_cost_usd.description: Must not exceed the emergency ceiling; a proposal above it must be rejected outright, not partially approved.

justification.description: Why the $0-default pipeline cannot achieve the goal without this service.

status.description: Only 'approved' permits any paid call. Default/initial value is 'proposed'.

requires_explicit_user_approval.description: Always true. No automatic-approval path exists.

approved_by.description: Set only when status is 'approved' — who (the project owner) approved it.
